title: Redux Patterns
description: Learn advanced Redux patterns for scalable applications.
longDescription: As applications grow, raw Redux can become unwieldy. This module teaches essential patterns for scaling: normalizing state with createEntityAdapter, using RTK Query for data fetching, and computing derived data with memoized selectors. These patterns keep your state consistent, your code DRY, and your app performant.
whatYouLearn: Fetch and cache data with RTK Query
